records.subject: spec-guard-codex
evidence: command:codex plugin marketplace add haigeerlab/spec-guard-plugin --ref v0.41.0
result:spec-guard@spec-guard-marketplace reports version 0.41.0, installed and enabled; its marketplace checkout resolves to the tagged merge commit a69acc41ae2f84f44515fb36ca6e15b616fb91d2

result:refreshing the marketplace alone did not upgrade the installed copy -- the marketplace root held 0.41.0 while `codex plugin list` still reported 0.40.0 across fresh processes, because the CLI reads ~/.codex/plugins/cache/<marketplace>/<plugin>/<version>/; `codex plugin add` was required
result:`codex plugin marketplace add` refuses an existing name pinned to a different ref, so the pinned-ref upgrade is remove-then-add, not upgrade
